payload.summary: Partial research completed under task_819b353754ad86a6dfee6eda50c3387218f9520ba72f3df8bab80734a66742ba: pinned Laya 0.3.28 multilingual/322M ran locally without training on 96 synthetic pairs (32 families, English/Hebrew/cross). Four-way relation 33/96; binary exact identity 43/96. It detected 23/24 true identities but made 52/72 false identities, precision 30.7%, recall 95.8%. No truncation/errors, median two-question CPU latency 0.774s, sampled peak RSS 2.14 GiB. This schema/checkpoint is not ready for autonomous duplicate merging. Corpus labels are author-defined and not independently adjudicated. Model alternatives/fine-tuning/real-scale retrieval remain unfinished.
